description: Apple QuickTime Player on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. QuickTime Player is preinstalled on macOS at /System/Applications/QuickTime Player.app, so install_quick_time_player.sh only verifies the bundle. setup_quick_time_player.sh seeds preferences in com.apple.QuickTimePlayerX to suppress the first-launch Open dialog, disable the iCloud document picker, and pre-create ~/Movies / ~/Documents where per-task source and recording outputs live. Verifiers use QuickTime's published AppleScript scripting interface (`tell application "QuickTime Player" to …`) to read live document/playback state — this works over SSH because the scripting goes through Apple Events directly to the app and is not subject to the TCC trap that blocks `System Events` AX. Shipped tasks: `launch_quick_time_player` (env-up smoke) and `play_target_audio_clip` (media-playback verification). Future task families that the AppleScript surface unlocks include audio/screen recording, trim, and movie export — those are not implemented today; add them under tasks/ if needed.
